camel_example: aliyun cloudauth-intl Mobile2MetaVerifyIntl --region cn-hangzhou --UserName '张0' --ProductCode MOBILE_2META --Mobile 18600001234 --ParamType normal --version 2022-08-09 --method POST --force
description_en: Verifies the mobile phone number and name
kebab_example: aliyun cloudauth-intl mobile-2-meta-verify-intl --product-code MOBILE_2META --param-type normal --user-name '张0' --mobile 18600001234 --region cn-hangzhou
name: Mobile2MetaVerifyIntl

parameters.help_en: The product code. Set the value to MOBILE_2META
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en:
The parameter type. Valid values:

normal: No encryption.
md5: MD5 encryption
parameters.help_zh:
参数类型：

normal：不加密
md5：md5加密
parameters.name: param_type

parameters.help_en:
The name.

If paramType is set to normal, enter the plaintext name.
If paramType is set to md5, enter the ciphertext name, which is a 32-character lowercase MD5 string
parameters.help_zh:
姓名：

paramType 传 normal 时：传入姓名明文。
paramType 传 md5 时：传入姓名密文（输入32位小写md5字符串）
parameters.name: user_name

parameters.help_en:
The mobile phone number.

If paramType is set to normal, enter the plaintext mobile phone number.
If paramType is set to md5, enter the ciphertext mobile phone number, which is a 32-character lowercase MD5 string
parameters.help_zh:
手机号码。

当paramType取值normal时，输入明文
当paramType取值md5时，传入手机号码密文，输入32位小写md5字符串
parameters.name: mobile

BizCode.description_en:
The verification result code. Valid values:
1: The verification is consistent.
2: The verification is inconsistent.
3: No record is found
BizCode.description_zh:
核验结果码。
1：核验一致
2：核验不一致
3：未查得

IspName.description_en:
The name of the carrier. Valid values:

CMCC: China Mobile.
CUCC: China Unicom.
CTCC: China Telecom
IspName.description_zh:
运营商名称

CMCC：移动
CUCC：联通
CTCC：电信
